patches.summary: IQAir website API base URL moved from /v1 to /v2.
patches.reason: AirVisual retired /v1 (sign-in and devices return 404 since ~2026-07-13); /v2 serves the same request and response shapes.
patches.validated_outcome: Live 2026-10-30: v2 signin 200 with id+loginToken; v2 /users/{id}/devices 200 with the same current.{aqi,pm25,co2,humidity,temperature} shape.
